summary.text: Alani Nu is a wellness and energy drink brand founded in 2018, sold at major US retailers and online at alaninu.com.
Celsius Holdings (Nasdaq: CELH) acquired Alani Nu from its Congo Brands-backed owners in 2025 for $1.8 billion, including $150 million in tax assets.
Alani Nu passed $1 billion in trailing 52-week retail sales as of April 2025 and moved into PepsiCo's U.S. and Canadian distribution system in August 2025.

Marketing for Alani Nu now sits under Celsius Holdings CMO Rishi Daing, with Chief Creative Officer JoBeth Fink, a longtime Alani Nu creative leader, and Chief Brand Officer Kyle Watson reporting to him.

The brand leans on limited-edition seasonal drops, including the fall 2026 Witch's Brew return, the Ruby Apple Potion Pack, the Voodoo Vanilla energy elixir, and a holiday Sugar Shoppe merch collection.
